Exploration requires assigning 2 guards and 2 drivers, plus 300 seconds of practical training. Carry 40 food, 1 tool, and 1 medicine. The one-way trip takes 180 seconds; after en-route consumption, leftover rations return to the original storehouse with the vehicle.

Peace talks: This city contributes 80 knowledge and the local area contributes 20. After the treaty is signed, trade must be established, the embankment clinic repaired, and the agreement honored continuously for 600 seconds.

Armed squad: Requires assigning 4 guards and 2 drivers, plus 300 seconds of practical training. Carry 120 food, 4 tools, and 4 medicine. After reaching shore, there is a 60-second decision window; a firefight on site takes 180 seconds. If the other side has defenses, the firefight kills 1 person on each side and injures 1 more on our side. Victory allows troops to be sent to garrison the area, but does not allow direct annexation.

Garrison duty occupies 2 guard job slots and every 10 seconds consumes 2 food, 0.2 knowledge, 0.05 tools, and 0.1 medicine. Voluntary withdrawal requires 4 rations for the journey and 0.2 tools; a supply interruption lasting 60 seconds also triggers automatic withdrawal. Guards walk home for 180 seconds, and their job slots are freed only after they arrive.

First send a regional cargo vehicle to trade, restore local trust, and repair “Ferry Medical Services and Embankment Repairs.” Then this city contributes 120 knowledge and the local area contributes 20 to formally make peace. Accession can be discussed only after self-governance is restored. Once citizenship is granted and the agreement has been honored continuously for 600 seconds, local residents are formally entered into the common law register.

The injured person's original bed remains reserved, and they cannot work while recovering. After returning to this city by vehicle, they consume 0.5 food and 0.2 medicine every 10 seconds. After 120 seconds of treatment, they recover and return to duty.
